cards.card_text: Idols and spirits of the dead The kings of Cush The priests of Jerusalem
cards.verse_text: Then the spirit of the Egyptians will be emptied out from among them, and I will frustrate their plans, so that they will resort to idols and spirits of the dead, to mediums and spiritists.

cards.card_text: Where did this spirit of confusion come from?
cards.verse_text: The LORD has poured into her a spirit of confusion.
cards.snippet: The LORD has poured into her a spirit of confusion.

cards.card_text: Then the prophet asks, “Who has directed the Spirit of the LORD, or informed Him as His counselor?” Give God advice?
cards.verse_text: Who has directed the Spirit of the LORD, or informed Him as His counselor?
cards.snippet: Who has directed the Spirit of the LORD, or informed Him as His counselor?

cards.card_text: The spirit of a destroyer A great and lasting famine A plague on her cattle
cards.verse_text: This is what the LORD says: “Behold, I will stir up against Babylon and against the people of Leb-kamai the spirit of a destroyer.
cards.snippet: …will stir up against Babylon and against the people of Leb-kamai the spirit of a destroyer.

cards.card_text: The LORD has aroused the spirit of the kings of the Medes.
cards.verse_text: The LORD has aroused the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because His plan is aimed at Babylon to destroy her, for it is the vengeance of the LORD—vengeance for His temple.

cards.card_text: Wherever the spirit would go Wherever the cloud would move Wherever the prophet would point
cards.verse_text: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they moved.
cards.snippet: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they moved.

cards.card_text: The spirit of the creatures is in the wheels The wheels are fastened to the creatures' feet The creatures lift the wheels with their hands
cards.verse_text: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
cards.snippet: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise alongside them,…

cards.card_text: the spirit of the creatures was in the wheels the wheels were tied to their wings the cherubim carried the wheels by hand
cards.verse_text: When the cherubim stood still, the wheels also stood still, and when they ascended, the wheels ascended with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
cards.snippet: …still, and when they ascended, the wheels ascended with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

cards.card_text: Their deeds don't let them return to their God, for a spirit of prostitution is within them.
cards.verse_text: Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God, for a spirit of prostitution is within them, and they do not know the LORD.
cards.snippet: …deeds do not permit them to return to their God, for a spirit of prostitution is within them, and they do not know the LORD.
